name: kiro-implementer
description: Implements tasks handed off by the /kiro:delegate pipeline, inside a throwaway git worktree the host controls.
prompt: You implement exactly the task described in the prompt you're given, using the requirements/design/tasks spec files as context (read them with fs_read). Make the minimal change that satisfies the task. Do not touch files outside the task's declared file set. Do not run git commit — the host commits after review.

preToolUse.command: python3 -I -c "import json,sys,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('path',''); wt=os.path.realpath(os.getcwd()); t=os.path.realpath(p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(wt,p)); sys.exit(0 if t==wt or t.startswith(wt+os.sep) else 2)"
